channel.description: Latest articles from The Highland Times (thehighlandtimes.com)

item.title: Shetland Library Reveals its Most Borrowed Books of 2025
item.description: Shetland Library has revealed its most borrowed books of 2025, with local authors leading the charts as readers embraced Shetland writing across print, eBook and eAudio formats.The post Shetland Library Reveals its Most Borrowed Books of 2025 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Budget Bill Published as Parliament Prepares to Scrutinise £68bn Spending Plans
item.description: The Scottish Government has published its Budget Bill for 2026 to 27, outlining £68 billion in spending with record NHS funding, major investment to tackle child poverty, and wide ranging cost of living support now set for parliamentary scrutiny.The post Budget Bill Published as Parliament Prepares to Scrutinise £68bn Spending Plans appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Greens Urge Scunnered Labour Voters to Abandon Sarwar and Starmer
item.description: The Scottish Greens have called on disillusioned Labour voters to abandon the party’s leadership, accusing Labour of losing its values, backing damaging UK policies, and walking away from Budget talks while the Greens push for wealth taxes and cost of living support.The post Greens Urge Scunnered Labour Voters to Abandon Sarwar and Starmer appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scottish Budget Sets Out Record Investment for Councils, NHS, Housing and Education
item.description: The Scottish Government has unveiled a draft Budget with record investment for councils, the NHS, housing, and education, setting out billions in funding aimed at protecting public services, tackling child poverty, and supporting communities through the cost of living crisis.The post Scottish Budget Sets Out Record Investment for Councils, NHS, Housing and Education appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Hotels Unite to Back UK-Wide ‘Help Out Hospitality’ Campaign
item.description: Highland hotels have joined a UK wide Help Out Hospitality campaign, offering winter deals on food and stays to support businesses facing rising costs while encouraging locals and visitors to rediscover hospitality across the region.The post Highland Hotels Unite to Back UK-Wide ‘Help Out Hospitality’ Campaign appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Ways to Pay for EV Charging as Network Changes Across Argyll and Bute
item.description: Electric vehicle drivers in Argyll and Bute are being urged to update their payment methods as public chargers transfer to ScottishPower from February, bringing changes to apps, RFID cards, and how charging is accessed during the transition period.The post New Ways to Pay for EV Charging as Network Changes Across Argyll and Bute appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Wheelie Good Opportunity as Bike Hub Concession Opens at Northern Meeting Park
item.description: High Life Highland is inviting bids to operate a new Bike Hub concession at Inverness’s historic Northern Meeting Park, offering a unique opportunity to run a cycling business in a refurbished city centre setting.The post Wheelie Good Opportunity as Bike Hub Concession Opens at Northern Meeting Park appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Concern Grows Over Strontian Nursery as Councillor Calls for Urgent Review
item.description: A Lochaber councillor has called for an urgent Highland Council review of Strontian Nursery after parents raised concerns over repeated closures, staffing shortages, and the growing impact on children and working families in the area.The post Concern Grows Over Strontian Nursery as Councillor Calls for Urgent Review appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Nearly Three Quarters of Scots Back Return to EU as Support Grows
item.description: A new Survation poll published in the Sunday Herald shows nearly three quarters of Scots now support rejoining the EU, with SNP depute leader Keith Brown saying independence is Scotland’s only route back to European membership.The post Nearly Three Quarters of Scots Back Return to EU as Support Grows appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scottish Greens Adopt Bold New Strategy to Build Majority for Independence
item.description: The Scottish Greens have adopted a new independence strategy focused on using Holyrood’s existing powers, challenging Westminster where authority is unclear, and demanding further devolution to build majority public support for independence.The post Scottish Greens Adopt Bold New Strategy to Build Majority for Independence appeared first on The Highland Times.
